history.summary: A 1,184 sqft freehold 3BR in D14 (near Aljunied) at $1.5M ($1,267 PSF). Attractive freehold pricing and a healthy arena record, but only 2 URA transactions means almost no reliable appreciation signal for this small/old development.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold 3BR at $1,267 PSF and a $1.5M total is genuinely affordable for D14 and sits in a liquid price band, and the 307-199 arena record/elo 1343 are solid. But this is a 2001-vintage (24-year-old) development with only 2 URA transactions — a classic thin-data, low-liquidity boutique where exit could be slow. 830m (10-min) to Aljunied (EW9) is workable but not prime. Decent value, but the illiquidity and age keep it from a Buy.
red_flags: Only 2 URA transactions — appreciation entirely unverifiable
Low transaction velocity implies slow exit
catalysts: Freehold 3BR at sub-$1,300 PSF in D14 is cheap
